scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run scan:pii && npm run eval
scripts.dev: HIREFRAME_DEV_BUNDLE=1 npm run build -w @hireframe/functions && node scripts/prepare-dev-functions.ts && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-hireframe --ui "node scripts/dev.ts"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-hireframe "vitest run -c vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.deploy: node scripts/assert-ci.ts && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,storage,functions --project prod --non-interactive
